channel.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
channel.desc: Eternal life begins with truly knowing God (John 17:3). But a misunderstood view of His character has left many hearts in spiritual darkness. This week we dive deep into Scripture to uncover the beauty of God's goodness, mercy, truth, and unfailing love. As the Bible reveals who God really is, His character shines as the final message of mercy to the world-a revelation of love that saves and transforms. While we can never fully comprehend God, we can know Him more deeply.
